work_packages.name: A record shows where a builder's session goes: the model's own time, each kind of command and each wait
work_packages.quality_bar: As checkable as a `cargo build --timings` report: every minute of a session sits in one named part, the parts add up to the session's wall time, and a reader can trace any figure back to the lines it came from.

items.statement: The record splits the wall time of every builder session of track 6's work packages, from 20 November 2026 to this work package's starting commit, into three kinds of part: the model's own time; commands, by what they ran (a build or lint, tests the builder chose, `./dev check`, an item's check, the merge, anything else); and waits (for a lock, behind another merge, and a command that only sleeps or polls). It gives each part for each work package and for all of them together, and gives the time between one work package's sessions apart from the sessions themselves. The parts of a session add up to its wall time, and time the sources cannot place is a part of its own.
